question: Which of the following state does** NOT** share its boundary with Bangladesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India shares a 4,096-km-long border with Bangladesh** which touches **Assam, Tripura, Mizoram, Meghalaya, and West Bengal.**
 
• Manipur shares borders with **Nagaland, Assam, Mizoram, and Myanmar**. 
 
 
• **N Biren Singh** is the present **CM of Manipur**. (Aug 2021)
 
• **Shri La. Ganesan** is the **Governor of Manipur**.
